name: Ripe Crop Marker
summary: Puts a small golden sparkle above fully grown crops so you can spot what is ready to harvest from across the field.
logoPrompt: A single golden wheat sheaf with a small bright four-pointed sparkle above its top

bullets: Five crops in the first release

description: **Ripe Crop Marker shows a small golden sparkle above every crop that is ready to harvest, so you no longer have to squint at your fields.**
- Fully grown wheat, carrots, potatoes, beetroots and nether wart get a bright sparkle just above their leaves.
- The sparkle only appears on the last growth stage, so it shows up exactly when the crop gives its full harvest.
- The plants themselves keep the vanilla look: not a single pixel of the crop is changed.
- The sparkle sits on every side of the plant, so you see it from any direction.
Put the zip into the `resourcepacks` folder of your game, then turn it on under Options > Resource Packs.
- Resource pack for Minecraft: Java Edition 1.21, 1.21.1 and 26.3. It only changes five textures, so you can add or remove it at any time.
- Works on servers too; only you see the sparkles.
- New features arrive with updates, see each file's changelog.
Found a bug or want a sparkle on another plant? Leave a comment.
